## PENDING CARE SETTING CONSOLIDATION
This page is pending SME review to merge inpatient/outpatient/ER-UC guidance into a single combined recommendation. Until that review is complete, each care setting's original content is shown separately below.
## INPATIENT:
[Help and Legend](general-information-legend)

# EMPIRIC TREATMENT: HOSPITAL ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (HAP)

Development of pneumonia 48 hours or more after hospital admission.

# Empiric Treatment (see below for MRSA history or clinically unstable patients)

Obtain MRSA nasal PCR and sputum culture before antibiotics, whenever possible.

Narrow therapy based on results of culture and susceptibility tests. Discontinue

MRSA and/or Pseudomonas coverage if not isolated from respiratory cultures.

Discontinue MRSA coverage if MRSA nasal PCR negative.

[Re-evaluate Nosocomial pneumonia at 72 hours](nosocomial-pneumonia-re-evaluation-at-72-hours)

Preferred:

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R for 7 days](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

<OR >

[Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R for 7 days](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)

Alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R for 7 days](psjizid-levofloxacin-750mg-iv-q24h)

# History of MRSA infection/colonization

# < OR > clinically unstable (e.g., intubation, hypotension)

ADD MRSA coverage to a regimen above. Discontinue MRSA coverage if MRSA nasal

PCR negative.

[< ADD > Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h  R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

# Clinically unstable (ICU level care, hypotensive, intubation)

# < AND > history of multi-drug resistant gram-negative rod isolate

[<ADD> Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV once R,O to an antimicrobial regimen above](psjizid-tobramycin-5-mg-kg-iv-once)

## ER/UC:
[Help and Legend](general-information-legend)

# EMPIRIC TREATMENT: HOSPITAL ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (HAP)

Development of pneumonia 48 hours or more after hospital admission.

# Empiric Treatment (see below for MRSA history or clinically unstable patients)

Obtain MRSA nasal PCR and sputum culture before antibiotics, whenever possible.

Narrow therapy based on results of culture and susceptibility tests. Discontinue

MRSA and/or Pseudomonas coverage if not isolated from respiratory cultures.

[Re-evaluate Nosocomial pneumonia at 72 hours](nosocomial-pneumonia-re-evaluation-at-72-hours)

Preferred:

[Cefepime 2 gm IV STAT R](psjizid-pna-cefepime-2gm-iv-stat-er-uc)

<OR >

[Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV STAT R](psjizid-pna-piperacillin-tazobactam-4-5-gm-stat-er-uc)

Alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Levofloxacin 750 mg IV STAT R](psjizid-pna-levofloxacin-750mg-iv-stat-er-uc)

# History of MRSA infection/colonization

# < OR > clinically unstable (e.g., intubation, hypotension)

ADD MRSA coverage to a regimen above. Discontinue MRSA coverage if MRSA nasal

PCR negative.

[< ADD > MRSA Nares Screening + vancomycin 15mg/kg IV STAT R](orz-set-abx-pna-vancomycin-stat-and-mrsa-eruc)

# Clinically unstable (ICU level care, hypotensive, intubation)

# < AND > history of multi-drug resistant gram-negative rod isolate

[<ADD> Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV STAT R,O to one of the regimens above](psjizid-tobramycin-5-mg-kg-iv-er-uc)
